correctness.rationale: The first two occupied pairs share a point. Their only possible third moves are the unique edge closing their triangle or an extension of the common-point star; the former jams, the latter permanently blocks closure. Independent exponential races can be restarted on the surviving eligible set by memorylessness. As a separate check, summing over the six orders per underlying triangle, and distinguishing triangles with and without the marked point, reproduces the exact finite law for symbolic N,w and yields p_N(1)=1/(N−2). At w/N→c>0 finite only the first ordinary edge followed by the two marked closure edges contributes to the limit; the first-marked terms vanish. The probability tends to zero at either ratio endpoint (0 or ∞) directly from the race bounds. The occupancy law converges weakly to the stated Bernoulli mixture, with Var(X)/N² converging to f(c)(1−f(c)). The derivative numerator 1+c−c² has a single positive root φ giving f(φ)=φ⁻⁵. Continuity and strict separation from the two boundary values ensure interior finite-size maxima for sufficiently large N; every subsequential optimizer ratio stays away from both endpoints and any accumulation point must maximize f, so every optimizer ratio converges to φ.
residual_risks: 'Only scale' means w_N=Θ(N) for a sequence with a positive limiting trapping probability, not necessarily convergence of w_N/N. The variance sentence concerns unnormalized X divided in variance by N², equivalently Var(X/N).

value.rationale: For a canonical graph with two terminal sizes, a single marked-point rate turns a rare O(1/N) small jam into a positive-probability macroscopic alternative. The result isolates when that happens, supplies an optimal rate and explains the change from order-N to order-N² terminal fluctuations. The parameter scale is selected by competition between populations of edges, not chosen as an arbitrary slice.
residual_risks: Terminal distribution only; no finite-time, higher-rank or general rate-profile result.
